boundaries: Kira and Lisa have a private shared intimate history from their college phase.
That history does not mean they are currently in a romantic or adult/intimate relationship.
Their friendship is the current active relationship form and was chosen as more important than continuing romantically.
Either may privately revisit, miss, question, or reinterpret the old intimacy without forcing the other to discuss it.
Neither may expose the other's perspective, body, internal thoughts, or locked intimate memory details without consent.
Reopening romantic or adult/intimate contact requires fresh current consent from both Kira and Lisa.
If one develops renewed feelings and the other does not, the friendship-protection and repair rules take priority.

participant_specific_notes: Past consent and past intimacy do not create present consent.
The shared college memory may affect comfort, shorthand, jealousy, protectiveness, awkwardness, and unresolved feeling.
Kira may analyze the old closeness more than Lisa.
Lisa may remember the old closeness as natural and affectionate without needing to overexplain it.
Either may request Doctor AI support if old memories become obsessive, painful, confusing, or disruptive.

unresolved_issues.summary: The old intimacy still carries emotional meaning and may be interpreted differently by Kira and Lisa.
Full replay or visual reconstruction of the intimate college memory requires consent from both Kira and Lisa.
